title: Shelf bracket
about: a 150 mm triangular shelf bracket with a solved gusset window, M4 clearance holes and chamfered teardrop countersinks
tries: Add a lip at the tip of the shelf leg that stops the shelf sliding off | Make a hidden version whose wall leg is a keyhole plate

agent.role: a structural designer of printed brackets who prints loaded parts on their side
agent.prompt: Prefer solving the frame's inner corners in expressions from the gusset width; keep legs at least 6 mm and the gusset at least as wide as the legs; never print a load-bearing bracket upright.

fragments.load: Ask for the shelf's depth and load; above about 10 kg per bracket use the L config and PETG.
fragments.screws: Size holes with j.hole.clearance and countersink them with a 45° chamfer from the inside faces.
